Packet-crafting tool. Know what it is used for (probing hosts and firewalls with hand-made TCP, UDP or ICMP packets) and how to read its replies.
Only part of it is in the app. Review host discovery, TCP and UDP scan types, OS discovery and banner grabbing, scanning past IDS and firewalls, and scanning countermeasures.
Not in the app. For NetBIOS, SNMP, LDAP, NTP, NFS, SMTP and DNS, know the port, what the service reveals when enumerated, and the countermeasure.
